mono.subject: oscar-best-picture-003
mono.title: 西线无战事
mono.titleEnglish: All Quiet on the Western Front

phrase.zh: 愿每一个年轻的生命，都能走出战场。
phrase.en: May every young life find a way beyond the battlefield.

visual.zh: 为1930年《西线无战事》独立创作的反战拼贴，以空钢盔、断开的铁丝网与蝴蝶表达脆弱的生命；不是电影剧照或海报。
visual.en: An original anti-war collage for the 1930 All Quiet on the Western Front, using an empty helmet, severed barbed wire and a butterfly to evoke life's fragility. Not a movie still or poster.

background.zh:
影片讲述一群年轻人加入第一次世界大战中的德军，在西线经历战争现实的故事，并于1930年获得第三届奥斯卡最佳影片奖。画面以遗留的装备和一只蝴蝶表达生命与战争的冲突；这是艺术解读，不重现某个具体镜头。
第3届奥斯卡最佳影片：西线无战事。颁奖年份 1930；参评年份 1929/30。
background.en:
The film follows young men who join the German army during World War I and confront the realities of combat on the Western Front. It won Best Picture at the third Academy Awards in 1930. Abandoned equipment and a butterfly interpret the conflict between life and war; this is not a reconstruction of a specific shot.
Academy Awards ceremony 3 (1930), Best Picture: All Quiet on the Western Front. Eligibility year: 1929/30.
